name: engine-analysis
description: Runs the one analyze function that turns a change-set into an immutable result with groups, graph, and ordering.

name: engine-changes
description: Captures exact Git comparisons and frozen snapshots of both sides, stored outside the reviewed repository.

name: engine-entities
description: The only wrapper around sem-core; exposes entities, edges, changes, and coverage gaps.

name: review-flows
description: Finds entrypoints, groups changes into flows, labels fallback grouping, and decides reading order.

name: review-anchors
description: Gives code locations stable IDs and re-finds them in later snapshots as exact, moved, ambiguous, or missing.

name: review-evidence
description: Collects model-free facts and artifacts, and finds the tests, comments, imports, and callers next to each entity.

name: review-claims
description: Stores agent claims pinned to anchors, links them to evidence, records reviewer decisions, and handles pointing.

name: review-queue
description: Delivers reviewer feedback to agents and keeps their replies, questions, and resolution state.

name: review-boundaries
description: Checks change-sets against a project's declared boundaries and turns accepted claims into versioned, scoped rules.

name: workspace-reviews
description: User-level store of projects, agent threads, worktrees, and review sessions, with an append-only event log.

name: review-visualizers
description: Built-in charts and visualizer specs, each tied to its data source and author.

name: provider-tools
description: The single plugin contract for outside tools: what they can do, what they may touch, and whether they worked.

name: surface-host
description: The daemon process: serves the web app, HTTP API, and MCP, runs bounded jobs, and publishes its address.

name: surface-mcp
description: Exposes review operations as MCP tools over streamable HTTP and stdio for agents.

name: surface-cli
description: Command-line subcommands that call the daemon, or analyze in process, and print results.

name: surface-web
description: React app shell: session switching, application state, live updates, and generated API types.

name: view-source
description: Reading view: flow groups in order, source with inline claims, and adjacent tests, comments, imports, and callers.
